actions.title: Join the Committee
actions.description: Help decide who comes to campus and bring the next event to life.
actions.details: Speakers & Stage is open to all Duke students! As a committee member, you'll help select speakers, plan events, promote programs, and possibly even host an event. Bring your ideas and help create memorable experiences for the Duke community.

actions.title: Suggest a Speaker or Topic
actions.description: Whose voice would you like to hear? Help shape the conversation at Duke.
actions.details: Have a speaker in mind or a topic you'd love to explore? Share your ideas with us and help shape future Speakers & Stage events.

actions.title: Collaborate With Us
actions.description: For student organizations, departments, and partners interested in working with S&S.
actions.details: Interested in bringing an event to campus together? We welcome collaborations with student organizations, academic departments, and campus partners to create meaningful and engaging programs.

actions.title: Contact
actions.description: Have a question for Speakers & Stage?
actions.details: We'd love to hear from you! Reach out with questions, ideas, or inquiries about our events and committee.
